Aisha (CSM): Quick sync — GreenWave reserved pool activation Tue 2026-04-07 09:00 PT. Need final sign-off on quota carve, autoscale policy, and loadtest script. Customer is in trial; renewal at risk if perf issues. Main asks: target ~2k concurrent users, median prompt ~150 tokens, marketing may cause short bursts.
Rafael (Eng): Got it. What are our SLA targets and which model variants are we planning to serve?
Aisha (CSM): Target p95 <= 750ms, p99 < 2s for critical routes. Start on rw-1.3-q4 (quant) with fallback to rw-1.3-fp16. Devon (Customer): Confirmed expected peak QPS ~1800 during initial week.
Priya (SRE): Proposed autoscale: keep GPU util target 65%. Scale-up when sustained >75% for 60s, scale-down after 5m. Add headroom for prefix/KV cache priming. Circuit-breaker for non-critical routes.
Logan (Solutions): Load test plan (3 phases): baseline (100 users), ramp (100 -> 2k over 20m), soak (2k for 30m). Script example: 
```bash
rwi-load -endpoint https://api.redwood.test/generate -concurrency {{C}} -rate {{R}} -payload ./samples/prompt.json
```
Token distribution: 70% short (<128), 25% mid (128-512), 5% long (>512). Include error-injection pass.
Rafael (Eng): Add KV cache priming: run ~5k prefix populates per route pre-traffic. Recommend continuous batching with max_batch=256 and latency tiering (low-latency queue for critical routes).
Priya (SRE): Failure modes to plan: GPU OOM -> fallback to quantized model variant + shed non-critical routes. Alerting rule: if p95 > 1.5s for 3 consecutive 1m windows, trigger automated fallback and page.
infra-bot: Scheduled: greenwave-pool activation at 2026-04-07T09:00:00Z by @rj-deploy. Autoscale policy applied: greenwave-autoscale-v1.
Aisha (CSM): Action items — 1) Eng: confirm batch/max_batch & model variant readiness (Rafael). 2) SRE: import alert rules + canary probe (Priya). 3) Solutions: provide final load script + run schedule and Jenkins job (Logan). 4) CSM: I'll update kickoff doc and capture feedback checkpoint after first 24h (me).
Rafael (Eng): Will validate max_batch=256, test continuous batching, and exercise fallback path by 2026-04-05 EOD.
Priya (SRE): I'll add synthetic canary every 2m, build dashboards, and rehearse failover steps.
Logan (Solutions): I'll post load script, job links, and plan 3 dry runs on staging before Tue. Suggest one dry run with 50% concurrency to validate priming.
Devon (Customer): We can prep test accounts and are willing to move the marketing blast by 2h if you need extra time.
Aisha (CSM): Noted. Renewal health: flagged as "at risk" if activation slips more than 48h past scheduled. I'll capture this in the account health doc and set a feedback checkpoint at +24h and +72h post-activation. :eyes:
Rafael (Eng): One dependency: quant kernel patch from kernel-team for rw-1.3-q4 perf. Pinging @kernel-team for ETA.
Priya (SRE): Runbook snippet for rollback: 1) set routing to fallback-model, 2) cap concurrency per-route to 500, 3) notify CSM + open incident. Keep minutes and call if we enter >2h degraded mode.
Logan (Solutions): thumbs up :thumbsup: Adding small postmortem template to the runbook so feedback capture is structured.
Aisha (CSM): Thanks — I'll run a 30m preflight call Mon 17:00 PT. Invite sent to Eng/SRE/Solutions + customer. Please add any missing risks here so I can include them in the kickoff.
